description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [MAG, RES and MND +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Magus of Earth] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Magus of Earth
description.text: Grants Magus of Earth +1 after using three of Synchrospell Earth or Breachspell Earth, removed after triggering, removed if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]
